movelist.name: Fury Cutter
movelist.effect: If Fury Cutter is used successfully and consecutively on the same target, the Damage Base is increased by +4 to a maximum of 16. For example, the first hit would have a DB of 4; the second hit a DB of 8; the third hit a DB of 12; the fourth and further hits a DB of 16. If Fury Cuter misses or fails to damage its target, its Damage Base resets.

movelist.name: Razor Shell
movelist.effect: Razor Shell lowers the Target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on an Even-Numbered Roll.

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Water Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Fire Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Fire Type Move, the coat is removed.

movelist.name: Tail Whip
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.effect: The user gains Last Chance with Water.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Critical Hits; they are instead normal hits. Defensive.
